content: Jaa copi noquen Jesus shinanquin sirijanahue, hea huetsabaan. Hehbe Papan baquebo hihxon, Papan noque jatihibi quenahi honanxon rihbi noquen Jesus shinannahue. Papan ta jaa raannishqui. Noquen yohuanxonnica hihnon rihbi ta jaa janenishqui. Jaa tah non jatihixonbi honanai.
Papan jihuetahbo jisxonquin Moisesnin jatihibi sirijaquin hahxonni quescajaribiquin ta noquen Hihbaan jaiqui.

Xobojanicahton sirijaquin xobojahiya tah non jahuen xobo siri jisi. Jascarax bi cah non xobo hihbo qui hashoan rihbi siripi yohuanai, xobojati honanai copi. Jascarihbihi tah non Moises siri jisxon, noquen Hihbo hashoan sca siri jisi.
Xobojanicahton xobojaha copi noquen xobobo jai quesca rihbi ta noquen Papan Jahue hahca jatihibi sca jaiqui.
Papan noque nincamayaxihqui joi non nincacoinnon ta Moisesnin sirijaquin teexonnishqui, Papan xobohoxon teexonai joni hihxon.

Jahuen teexonai jonima bi Papan baque hihxon ta Criston sca Papan baquebo jisxonihqui. Papan baquebo hen hihqui bi tah hen noquebi yohihi. Jointinin honanax, jonibo qui hihtimahpaxma non noquen Hihbo jenehaxma, jaya non joihibo tah non jahuen siri baquebo qui.
Jaa copi Dios Yoshin Siripan yohini joi nincacoinnahue:

content.text: Papan jato teneresnon hihxon nihi naman cahuan cahuanai nincayosmabo janí quescayamanahue.
Jahuentiho tene Papan jaiquin hihxon ta maton papabaan hea janoxon tana tanacannishqui. Coshixon hen jato hahxon hahxonai jisxon bi ta cuarenta bari hea tanarescannishqui.
Jaa copi tah hen jato qui sinaxon yohinihqui: Huetsajaquin shinanax ta jascabihi paramehcaniqui. Heen bahibo honanaiboma ta qui.
Sina sinaxon tah hen hihti yohinihqui: Heen jihue janin ta jaabo jahuentianbi hihquiyamayaxihcanihqui.

content: Coiramenahue, hea huetsabaan. Nincatima tiromabo shinanbo maton jointi janin jamis, tiromahi. Jascapa shinanbaan ta mato noquen jihuemanica Papa Dios nincamatimajahiqui.
Tsoabi hohchapan paramehtax nincayosmayamanon hihquish jatihibi neten joni huetsa betan yohinannahue. Rahmabi nincacoinhue Dios Yoshiman yohihah histon nincacoinahbo yohinannahue.
Nincacoinmenoxon non mahuanoxon caman jascabijaquin sirijaquin nincacaibo tah non Criston hahbe jihuetibo qui.

content.text: Rahma sca jahuen joi nincacax nincayosmayamanahue. Papan jato teneresnon hihxon nihi naman cahuan cahuanai nincayosmabo janí quescayamanahue.

content: Papan jato nincamaha bi ta noquen papabo nincacatsihyamanishqui. Egipto mai janinhax Moises betan joníbo jatihibi ta jascapahbo janishqui.
Papan ta cuarenta bari jato qui sina tenenishqui. Hohchanish copi ta nihi naman mehax mahuatah sca racarenencannishqui.
Nincayosmabo copi ta jaabo yohihi, Heen jihue janin ta jahuentianbi hihquiyamayaxihcanihqui, Papan janishqui.
Jan yohini quescabi ta janishqui: nincayosmabo copi jano hihquiti hahtipahyamahibo.
